t: Paid planetarium software for exploring the sky on a computer.
steps: Visit starrynighteducation.com and the Simulation Curriculum store to compare editions.
Ask the vendor which edition fits your grade levels and devices.
Contact the school's education office to buy a single or multi-seat license.
Ask IT to install the desktop app or set up the browser classroom edition.
Ask the vendor how student data is handled before students sign in.
Try the lesson plans on one computer.
Free Stellarium is an alternative to compare.
